calls.title: Geoffrey Bell and Ashley Stirrup + Scott Keller
calls.summary: Geoffrey Bell (Ford Credit's experimentation product manager) discussed pain points with Adobe Target, including DOM timing issues, micro frontend challenges, and expensive, slow support, while noting the need to connect online experiments to offline car sales. Ashley Stirrup (GrowthBooks sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) presented GrowthBook as a cheaper, warehouse-native alternative with better support, flexible pricing, and the ability to handle offline data. Next steps: Geoffrey may share Ford Motor's experimentation contacts for a broader discussion, and Logan
